author: Mehrp
body:
Hullo! ^-^ Me and toggle (iPhotoshop, Glimpsiucc) recently made a map and have gotten around to releasing it :3 (there was contribution from jozz as well) 
    
Map Download: We're not giving that yet ^-^
YML: In progress
Photos: 
http://gyazo.com/5be0c23d23efda27eb0fe04e59117928 -Left side
http://gyazo.com/d1bf31b56609b2c4001f59d2b03c5b3e -Center
http://imgur.com/MWRJu25,D9qnEUI,y94ghuv,JqzwYww,xICwU9K,MkpHbMq
We'll make a complete album soon :)
Features:
Unique design! (I was bored and was like "Why not have an upside down map? xd)
Equal variation! (You spawn in two different places to ensure one team doesn't have an advantage
Water portals! (Snazzy!)
No fall damage!
No fire damage!
speedy plates! (to access those far of places quickly)
Classic 'Iron supply with a few diamonds'
Hand made curves! (none of that /curve hogwash!)
That's it, hope you enjoy! (Suggestions for improvements are very welcome!)
